verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers Canny's MCP integration, SDK installation, feedback capture, and changelog features; nothing describes a structured hierarchy of features, components, or initiatives (e.g., boards, categories, sub-features) for organizing requests. canny-docs-5 vaguely mentions 'organize requests' via MCP but gives no detail on hierarchical structuring. Missing for 10: documentation of boards/categories/tags structure, evidence of nesting features under initiatives, or roadmap hierarchy tooling.
